claims.text: Hugo was the eldest child of Bruno Bracegirdle, born in . In his lifetime, he was notorious for borrowing books from Bilbo Baggins, though he rarely returned them. In he was a guest at Bilbo's Farewell Party, after which Bilbo left Hugo an empty bookcase in which he could store all those books.
